jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
LanguageWire is a global leader in language and content services, dedicated to helping brands achieve their full global potential. Since our founding in 2000, we have continuously evolved and developed unique technology to facilitate seamless multilingual communication. Our worldwide network of language experts, coupled with an intuitive online platform, makes it effortless for brands to translate and manage multilingual content. 
The role you'll play 

We're launching a new team dedicated to modernizing and expanding one of our customer-facing tools — and we're looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to help build it from the ground up. This isn't a legacy product handoff: you'll be joining at the very start, shaping both the technical direction and the team culture from day one. 
The current stack is Vue.js on the frontend and Python on the backend, but we're planning a migration to .NET in the near future. Because of this, we're looking for someone comfortable working across all three — Vue, Python, and .NET — who can help drive that transition while continuing to ship new features. As the senior engineer, you'll take a leading role in architecture decisions, technical direction, and mentoring as the team grows. 
The team you'll be a part of 

You'll be one of the founding members of a brand-new team, led by our Tech Team Lead. We're actively growing the team and expect to bring on a Product Manager and one additional Engineer alongside you. This means you'll have real influence over how the team is structured, how we work, and the technical foundations we build on — it's a rare chance to help define a team's culture and practices from the very beginning, rather than stepping into something already set. 

If you want to make a difference, make it with us by... 

Developing and maintaining applications, including front-end interfaces, back-end services, and databases 

Contributing to the architecture, design and implementation of new features and improvements 

Implementing best practices for code quality, testing and deployment automation 

Ensuring high-quality software through active participation in code reviews 

Actively engaging in sprint retrospectives, refinements, daily stand-ups, and other team processes 

Taking full ownership of the products and solutions you develop, eliminating bugs early in the process through TDD/BDD and other tests 

Leveraging AI-assisted development tools and workflows to increase engineering velocity, while maintaining code quality and rigor 

Sharing knowledge and supporting fellow developers, QA professionals, and support teams 

Supporting team leaders with your expertise and assist in customer meetings 

Owning CI/CD pipelines to ensure seamless operations 

In one year, you'll know you were successful if... 

You are fully integrated as part of the team and have built strong working relationships. 

You actively contribute to maintaining a positive, collaborative, and knowledge-sharing team atmosphere. 

You take full ownership of products and solutions, having delivered several major features to production with measurable impact. 

You share your expertise by mentoring mid-level and junior developers, helping them grow and succeed. 

You contribute to improving team processes, code quality, and technical decision-making. 

Desired Experience And Competencies 

What does it take to work for LanguageWire? 

What you'll need to bring 

Motivational and engaging with a "can do" attitude, fostering a positive team environment. 

Strong problem-solving and communication skills. 

Solid understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and best practices. 

Extensive experience with C# and the .NET ecosystem (.NET Core/.NET 6+, ASP.NET Web API, etc.) 

Experience with Python 

Solid understanding of RESTful API design and integration 

Familiarity with asynchronous programming and performance optimization in .NET 

Responsible for front-end codebases using Vue.js and/or TypeScript, collaborating closely with full-stack and frontend developers 

Sound understanding of frontend build tools and state management (Vuex, Pinia, or similar). 

Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and CI/CD practices 

Experience with automated testing frameworks (unit, integration, and end-to-end). 

Comfortable working in agile development environments and participating in sprint planning, code reviews, and peer mentoring 

Ability to collaborate effectively in cross-functional teams, including product, design, and QA. 

DevOps experience: CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Helm, etc.), Docker, Kubernetes, cloud services (Azure, AWS, or GCP). 

This will make you stand out 

Knowledge of microservices architecture and event-driven systems 

Proficiency with relational databases, particularly MSSQL and/or PostgreSQL 

Hands-on experience with Entity Framework (EF Core) and LINQ 

Familiarity with message brokers (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus) 

Strong focus on testing practices (unit testing, integration testing, test automation) 

Awareness of security best practices in software development 

Ability to mentor others and foster knowledge-sharing within the team 

Our perks 

Enjoy flat hierarchies, responsibility and freedom, direct feedback, and room to stand up for your own ideas   

Internal development opportunities, ongoing support from your People Partner, and an inclusive and fun company culture   

International company with over 300 employees. Offices in Copenhagen, Aarhus, Stockholm, Varberg, London, Leuven, Lille, Paris, Munich, Hamburg, Kiev, Gdansk, Atlanta, Finland and Valencia   

We take care of our people and initiate many social get-togethers from Friday Bars a to Summer or Christmas parties. We have fun!    

150 great colleagues in the Valencia office belonging to different business departments    

Excellent location in cool and modern offices in the city center, with a great rooftop terrace and a view over the Town Hall Square   

Private health insurance   

We have a hybrid work model called FlexiWire. We offer weekly flexibility, working three days in the office and two days from home. Together with your team, you can coordinate which days to collaborate in the office.   

Working in an international environment—more than 20 different nationalities   

A dog friendly atmosphere    

Big kitchen with access to organic fruits, nuts and biscuits and coffee.   

Social area and game room (foosball table, darts, and board games)   

Bike and car parking  

About LanguageWire  

At LanguageWire, we want to wire the world together with language. Why? Because we want to help people & businesses simplify communication. We are fueled by the most advanced technology (AI) and our goal is to make customer's lives easier by simplifying their communication with any audience across the globe.   

Our values drive our behavior 

We are curious. We are trustworthy. We are caring. We are ambitious.   

At LanguageWire, we are curious and intrigued by what we don't understand. We believe relationships are based on honesty and responsibility, and being trustworthy reinforces an open, humble, and honest way of communicating. We care and respect each other personally and professionally. We encourage authentic collaboration, invite feedback, and a positive social environment. Our desire to learn, build, and share knowledge is a natural part of our corporate culture.  

Working at LanguageWire — why we like it:   

"Once the purpose & values project had been rolled out, I felt a stronger connection and more engaged. Within our team, we care for each other, help each other on tasks, projects and we value different opinions. We truly lift each other up to be our best and ambitiously strive towards constantly improving on a professional and personal level." 
(Arpi, Application Support Team Lead, Valencia)  

Yes, to diversity, equity & inclusion   

In LanguageWire, we believe diversity in gender, age, background, and culture is essential for our growth. Therefore, we are committed to creating a culture that incorporates diverse perspectives and expertise in our everyday work.  
LanguageWire's recruitment process is designed to be transparent and fair for all candidates. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply, and we ensure that candidates are provided with an equal opportunity to demonstrate their competencies and skills.  

Want to know more?   
We can't wait to meet you! So, why wait 'til tomorrow? Apply today!   
If you want to know more about LanguageWire, we encourage you to visit our website!

jobs.description:
Nexthink is the leader in digital employee experience management software. The company provides IT leaders with unprecedented insight allowing them to see, diagnose and fix issues at scale impacting employees anywhere, with any application or network, before employees notice the issue. As the first solution to allow IT to progress from reactive problem solving to proactive optimization, Nexthink enables its more than 1,300 customers
to provide better digital experiences to more than 18 million employees. Dual headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland and Boston, Massachusetts, Nexthink has 9 offices worldwide.

Job Description

We are seeking a curious and versatile Cloud Infrastructure Engineer with a strong track record of deploying, integrating, and troubleshooting complex virtualization and cloud environments. As part of our VDI Lab team, you will be responsible for building and evolving the environments that our product teams rely on — standing up new VDI platforms, thin client operating systems, and cloud desktop services, and researching how to integrate emerging technologies into our infrastructure.

Because the position is highly cross-functional, the ability to communicate complex technical concepts in a clear and pragmatic way is essential. You will work side by side with product and engineering teams, and your work will become the foundation on which our endpoint capabilities are built and validated across virtualization and cloud desktop platforms.

Responsibilities

Build and evolve the virtualization environments our endpoint products run on, across the major VDI and cloud desktop platforms.
Automate it end to end: infrastructure as code, provisioning and image pipelines, so any engineer can get a working desktop on demand.
Keep it running across public cloud and on-prem — networking, identity, and monitoring.
Evaluate and integrate emerging endpoint technologies, from proof of concept to supported platform.
Work with product managers, engineering teams, and technology partners to unlock and validate new platform coverage.
Be the person other teams come to when they need to understand how a virtualization platform behaves.

Qualifications

Must have

BSc/BEng or master's in computer science, or equivalent experience
5+ years of professional cloud infrastructure experience
Deep hands-on experience with at least one major VDI/EUC platform — Citrix CVAD, Omnissa Horizon, Microsoft AVD / Windows 365, or Amazon WorkSpaces — and willingness to learn the others
Strong Windows Server and hybrid identity foundations (Active Directory, Entra ID)
A bias toward automation — Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, or whatever you've used to stop clicking through the same setup twice
English proficiency.

Where you've built depth
— we don't expect all of these; tell us which are yours

Additional VDI platforms, brokers, or gateways (NetScaler/ADC, UAG)
Hypervisor administration (vSphere/ESXi, Nutanix) and golden image lifecycle — build, optimization, patching, FSLogix
Networking for virtual desktops — VLANs, firewalling, TLS, site-to-site VPN to AWS or Azure
Cloud infrastructure on Azure or AWS, and CI/CD or image pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Packer)
Secure administration — RBAC, PIM, secrets management, vulnerability management
Thin client and endpoint management — IGEL UMS, Dell Wyse Management Suite, Intune
Synthetic testing / benchmarking — Login Enterprise (Login VSI) or similar

How you work

You can explain a platform constraint to a product manager and a design trade-off to an engineer on the same day
You're drawn to unfamiliar technology rather than wary of it — this role puts something new in front of you every quarter

Additional Information

We are the pioneers and trailblazers of a global IT Market Category (DEX) that is shaping the future of how the world works, giving our customers’ IT Teams total digital visibility across their enterprise. Our innovative solutions integrate real-time analytics, automation, and employee feedback across all endpoints. This enables our IT teams to solve complex technical challenges, create ever more productive workplaces, and deliver happy, satisfied employees in the digital workplace.

With over 1000 employees across 5 continents, Nexthink operates as One Team, connecting, collaborating and innovating to continuously grow. We call our employees ‘Nexthinkers’ and our commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equity is second to none. We currently have over 75 nationalities working with us, from all cultures and backgrounds, speaking many different languages.

IIf you are looking for a change and like a nice atmosphere, lots of challenges, and having fun while working, this is a great opportunity for you!  Check what we offer:

Permanent Contract and a competitive compensation package.
📍 Amazing centrally located offices near the Bernabeu Stadium.
🩺 Private Health Insurance (Sanitas) and daily meal vouchers of 11 EUR will be entirely covered by us.
🏡 Hybrid work model balancing office and remote work, with a structured approach for new hires to foster connections and onboarding.
🏖️ Flexible Hours and unlimited vacation (employees have unlimited paid time off on top of the 23 days of holidays we offer) plus 3 company-paid volunteer days.
🤸 Up to 25 EUR per month for a gym subscription.
🛴 Flexible compensation plan for childcare & public transportation.
🧑‍🏫 Reimbursement of up to 50% of the cost of English & Spanish classes.
🍉 Fresh fruit, cookies, soft drinks and protein shakes at the offie.
🍕 Regular company and team events like Pizza talks, Team Building activities, Christmas parties, hosting Meetups at the office and more!
📣 Bonuses for referring successful hires after three months of continuous employment.
🚚 We offer a relocation package to people who are coming from another country.

Please note that not all the benefits listed above are available for temporary, contract, and internship roles. To ensure you have the most up-to-date information, we recommend checking with your Recruitment Partner.

The base salary for this role is €42,000 – €70,000 gross per year, with a total on-target earnings (OTE) range of €46,000 – €77,000 including an annual performance bonus. You'll also be part of our broader total rewards package — including benefits tailored to where you live and how you work best.

We set our pay ranges using objective criteria: the scope and level of the role, the skills it takes to do it well, and the relevant market data. Ranges are reviewed every year to remain competitive and fair. We're transparent about this because we think you deserve to know what you're working towards from day one. In accordance with the EU Pay Transparency Directive (2023/970), we publish salary ranges on every Nexthink role. We won't ask what you currently earn or your previous salary. What matters to us is what this role is worth and whether it works for you. Nexthinkers come from all kinds of backgrounds, and that's what makes us stronger. We welcome applications from everyone.

Languages: English B2/C1

Proven ability to deliver complex features with a high degree of ownership and autonomy.
Experience making architectural decisions and evaluating technical trade-offs.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate ambiguity in complex systems.
A quality-focused mindset with experience improving engineering practices and development processes.
Experience mentoring engineers and collaborating effectively within cross-functional teams.
A quality-focused mindset with experience improving engineering practices and development processes.

Strong professional experience developing backend services with .Net.
Good experience developing frontend application on React/Next
Proven experience building, maintaining, and scaling production applications
Strong understanding of code architecture, design patterns, state management, asynchronous programming, and performance optimization. Understanding clean architecture and SOLID principles.
Experience designing and implementing automated testing strategies, including unit, integration, and UI tests.
Strong experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, and mobile release processes.
Strong understanding of software engineering best practices, including code quality, maintainability, security, and observability.
Experience working with Git-based development workflows and collaborative engineering practices.
Familiarity with analytics, performance monitoring, and feature flagging solutions.
Ability to evaluate technical trade-offs and contribute to architectural decisions across the mobile platform.

jobs.title: Fullstack Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Build your future with Sovos.

If you're seeking a career where innovation meets impact, you've come to the right place. As a global leader, Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth while revolutionising how businesses navigate the ever-changing regulatory landscape.

At Sovos, we're dedicated to more than just solving compliance challenges – we're committed to making a positive and lasting difference. Our teams operate on the modern edge of digital technology, working not only to solve complex business challenges but also to enrich our personal, professional, and local communities.

Our purpose-built systems provide the tools you need to thrive in a world where governments demand increased visibility, faster reporting and greater control over business processes. Excited about the possibilities? So are we!

Don’t worry if you don't check all the boxes – apply anyway. We're focused on hiring the right people, not just the "right" resume. It's not about what you've done elsewhere; it's all about what you're capable of doing here.

The Work You'll Do

At Sovos, our Core Platform and AI Platform
are the foundation that dozens of engineering teams build on. We're seeking a Fullstack Senior Engineer
who will design, build, and operate the platform services that power that foundation — services that are reliable, well-documented, and adoptable at scale.

This is a builder role at the center of the Sovos platform strategy. You'll work closely with the Platform Adoption
team to understand how teams are using what you build, close feedback loops quickly, and ensure that what ships is something the broader engineering organization can confidently rely on.

The Fullstack Senior Engineer
will own the design and delivery of platform services that span the Sovos portfolio — from identity and administration to AI capabilities and shared infrastructure
. Your work directly determines what other teams can build and how fast they can build it
.

More Specifically You Will

Building Platform Services That Scale Across the Portfolio

You'll design and deliver the Core Platform and AI Platform services that product teams depend on — things like identity, shared admin experiences, design system components, and AI infrastructure. Adoptability is a first-class requirement: services need to be well-designed, well-documented, and easy to integrate correctly.

Design and implement platform services with clear contracts, versioning strategies, and backward compatibility in mind
Build with adoption as a first-class concern — prioritize APIs, SDKs, and interfaces that are intuitive for consuming teams
Contribute to Core Platform components including identity, Sovos Admin, Mosaic design system, and Sovos Home
Build and maintain AI Platform infrastructure including tooling, integrations, and agentic service components
Establish engineering standards, patterns, and guardrails that make the right way the easy way for consuming teams

Partnering Closely with the Platform Adoption Team

You'll work together with the Senior Developers on the Platform Adoption team who are embedded with consuming teams.

Treat adoption friction as a product defect - actively seek feedback from the Adoption team and act on it
Collaborate on Skills and integration guidance to ensure what gets taught matches what's built
Participate in onboarding sessions, design reviews, and pairing with consuming teams when platform depth is needed
Provide timely support and clear escalation paths for teams hitting blockers in platform integration

Owning Quality, Reliability, and the Path to Production

Platform services are only as good as their uptime, and the confidence teams have in them. You'll lead testing strategies, participate in deployment planning, and take ownership of the operational quality of what you build — because what you ship is someone else's critical path.

Author and maintain comprehensive test plans — unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end — for platform services
Own the deployment lifecycle for platform components from development through staging to production
Establish observability practices (logging, metrics, alerting) so platform health is visible and actionable
Contribute to security and compliance reviews for platform services, particularly those touching identity and data
Participate in on-call rotations and lead incident response for platform-level issues

What We Need From You

7+ years of software engineering experience, with meaningful time building shared services, platforms, or infrastructure consumed by other engineering teams
Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and React for frontend platform components; experience with backend services in Java, .NET, or Node.js
Experience designing APIs, SDKs, or component libraries with developer experience as a primary consideration
Familiarity with identity and authentication patterns (OAuth/OIDC, SAML, SSO) is a strong plus
Experience or genuine enthusiasm for AI tooling, agentic frameworks, and integrating LLM-based capabilities into platform services
Strong instincts for testing strategy - you write tests because you care about what happens after you ship, not because someone asked you to
Excellent communication skills: you can explain platform design decisions and trade-offs to both engineering peers and non-technical stakeholders
A collaborative mindset - you view the teams building on your platform as customers, not consumers

What Does Sovos Offer You?

The tools to enhance your life – because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!

An opportunity to work with a global team
Bi-Weekly Meeting Free Days!
Mentoring Programs
Globally recognised Training and Development programs
Benefits

Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, color, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, national origin, disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.

Company Background

Sovos is a global provider of tax, compliance and trust solutions and services that enable businesses to navigate an increasingly regulated world with true confidence. Purpose-built for always-on compliance capabilities, our scalable IT-driven solutions meet the demands of an evolving and complex global regulatory landscape. Sovos’ cloud-based software platform provides an unparalleled level of integration with business applications and government compliance processes.

More than 100,000 customers in 100+ countries – including half the Fortune 500 – trust Sovos for their compliance needs. Sovos annually processes more than three billion transactions across 19,000 global tax jurisdictions. Bolstered by a robust partner program more than 400 strong, Sovos brings to bear an unrivaled global network for companies across industries and geographies. Founded in 1979, Sovos has operations across the Americas and Europe, and is owned by Hg and TA Associates. For more information visit http://www.sovos.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Twitter.

We are looking for an experienced Quality Engineering Architect to design and evolve advanced quality engineering solutions for complex enterprise environments. This role combines architecture ownership with hands-on software engineering, connecting automation, test data, environments, CI/CD and AI-enabled capabilities across the software development lifecycle. WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Develop and operationalize AI agents and LLM-based workflows for requirements analysis, scenario generation, coverage assessment, failure diagnosis and controlled self-healing, with appropriate evaluation, traceability, privacy and human oversight.
- Integrate automated quality controls into CI/CD pipelines, including quality gates, risk indicators and actionable feedback mechanisms.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- At least 8 years of relevant experience in Software Engineering, Quality Engineering or Test Automation, including at least 3 years with direct responsibility for architecture and technical delivery.
- Proven experience designing, implementing and operationalizing quality engineering or automation solutions across integrated applications and multiple teams.
- Strong software engineering capability, including modular design, automated testing, systematic debugging and code review practices.
- Experience defining test architecture and validation strategies across APIs, user interfaces and system integrations.
- Practical experience implementing at least one LLM or agent-based solution in operational use, including evaluation, failure handling, traceability and human oversight.
- Ability to evaluate architecture decisions across reliability, scalability, maintainability, security, implementation effort, operating costs and measurable value.

- Professional working proficiency in Portuguese and English.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Customer Capabilities Tribe’s mission is to deliver "end-to-end" customer-centric pricing, reporting and document-lifecycle solutions. We make sure this happens by empowering Business with self-service tools that accelerate the delivery of innovative products and services to market.

Our team is cross-functional and you will be working closely with IT Architects, BI Engineers, DevOps specialists, IT Systems and Business analysts to deliver modern solutions, using advanced technologies. We are inspired by a commitment to improvement, so you can expect to work in an environment that values collaboration and knowledge sharing.

We are currently looking for two Full Stack Engineers to join the Corporate Pricing Squad, where you will help calculate and manage profit margins for corporate customers, supporting transparent, data-driven pricing across the bank.

If you are passionate about backend .NET engineering, business logic and building reliable systems that support important financial decisions and processes, we want to hear from you.

You will:

Develop software that is trusted, testable, easily maintainable and reliable
Closely collaborate with business users, developers, IT architects and different teams within the bank
Seek continuous learning and improvement for yourself and your team
Contribute ideas that improve our engineering practices, ways of working and solution design.
Work with technologies such as .NET for custom solutions, React, MS SQL, AWS, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Terraform, and CI/CD to deliver high-quality solutions

About you:

Core engineering experience: 3+ years of full-stack development experience for distributed enterprise systems, with solid backend .NET experience, strong C# skills and experience developing maintainable services.
API and service development: Experience designing, developing and maintaining REST APIs that support robust, efficient and secure interactions between services and downstream consumers.
Cloud and DevOps: Experience building and operating backend services in a modern cloud environment, including AWS Public Cloud native services such as Lambda, S3 and DynamoDB.
Automation and infrastructure: Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps and infrastructure as code using Terraform, with a commitment to deploying changes safely and frequently.
Quality and security mindset: Ability to write effective unit tests and contribute to high-quality code through automated testing and good engineering practices, while working in a regulated environment where security, compliance, auditability and data protection matter.
Problem solving and collaboration: Excellent problem-solving skills, the ability to think algorithmically, and effective communication and teamwork skills.
Language skills: Upper-intermediate English, both written and verbal.

"We celebrate multiple approaches and points of view. We believe diversity drives innovation."

We offer:

Monthly salary range from 3680 EUR to 5520 EUR gross (based on your competencies relevant for the job).

Additionally, each Danske Bank employee receives employee benefits package which includes:

Growth opportunities: professional & supportive team, e-learnings, numerous development programs; (incl. professional certificates); 100+ professions for internal mobility opportunities.
Health & Well-being: a diverse, inclusive, work & life balance work environment; additional health insurance; mental well-being practices; partial psychologist counselling compensation; silence and sleep zones at the office; game rooms.
Hybrid working conditions: Work from home up to two days a week; home office budget after the probation period; modern Danske Campus workplace developed with input from anthropologists to support a strong employee experience.
Additional days of leave: for rest, health, volunteering, exams in higher education institutions, and other important activities. Moreover, for seniority with Danske Bank.
Monetary compensation package: accidents and critical diseases insurance; financial support in case of unfortunate events; travel insurance; 3rd Pillar Pension Fund contribution.

See all the benefits HERE.

Your job function (position) in the job contract will be Software Engineering.

If you would like to learn more about the role, you are welcome to contact Nicolaj Selsted via LinkedIn.

About Us

Danske Bank is a Nordic bank with bridges to the world around us. For 150 years, we have supported people and businesses in releasing their potential. A career with us is an opportunity to join a community of 22,000 colleagues in a culture where we are committed to Teaming Up, Owning It and Being Open. Together, we are on a journey to transform Danske Bank into a better bank. For our customers, our employees and the societies around us.

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Quality Engineer (all genders) - Vollzeit & Teilzeit
new_jobs.description:
Als Senior Software Quality Engineer
bist du ein zentraler Bestandteil unseres Teams und sicherst durch moderne Testmethoden und Tools die Qualität unserer Softwarelösungen in Branchen wie Automotive, Aerospace, Banking, Medical, Mobile und Energy.

Mit fundierter Erfahrung im Softwaretesten erkennst du Optimierungspotenziale, entwickelst maßgeschneiderte Lösungen, berätst Stakeholder und führst Proof of Concepts durch. Dein Blick für Details und das große Ganze macht dich zum gefragten Ansprechpartner für anspruchsvolle Projekte.

Gestalte mit uns die Softwarequalität von morgen!

Die Position ist sowohl in Vollzeit
als auch in Teilzeit
möglich.

Verantwortlichkeiten

Verschiedene Einsatzbereiche wie Automotive, Aerospace, Mobile, Insurance, Medical, Banking, Energy, etc. findest Du interessant und herausfordernd.
Du hast hohe Qualitätsansprüche und das Testen von Software macht Dir Spaß.
Du vermittelst in Deinen Projekten das nötige Bewusstsein und Wissen für Softwarequalität und begleitest den gesamten Softwareentwicklungsprozess.
Je nach Spezialisierung unterstützt Du unsere Projekte mit Deiner mehrjährigen Erfahrung in der Testautomatisierung, bei Last- und Performance-Tests, im Testdatenmanagement oder beim Aufbau und Betrieb von Testumgebungen.
Du siehst über den Tellerrand hinaus und behältst auch in Detaildiskussionen das große Ganze im Blick.
Du unterstützt unter anderem PreSales bei der Analyse von Kundenapplikationen und identifizierst, welche Testautomatisierungs- oder Last- und Performancetest-Werkzeuge zum Einsatz kommen können. Anschließend entwickelst Du Lösungsansätze und prüfst diese im Rahmen von Proof of Concepts.

Qualifikationen

Du verfügst über eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise, Eigeninitiative, Selbstständigkeit und eine hohe Lösungskompetenz.
Du sprichst fließend Deutsch (mindestens C1-Niveau) und hast gute Englischkenntnisse.
Mit Deiner hohen Einsatzbereitschaft bringst Du die notwendige Flexibilität und Mobilität für Kundeneinsätze bundesweit mit.

Erforderliche Fähigkeiten

Du verfügst über ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes technisches oder naturwissenschaftliches Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation und hast mindestens 5 Jahre Berufs- und/oder Projekterfahrung im Bereich Software-Testing.
Gängige Testwerkzeuge im Bereich der Testautomatisierung (z.B. OpenText ALM , OpenText Unified Functional Testing, Tosca, Playwright oder Selenium) oder im Bereich der Last- & Performancetests (z.B. Micro Focus Loadrunner, Apache JMeter, Neotys Neoload bzw. verschiedene Performancemonitore wie z.B. Grafana, Prometeus, Datadog oder Kibana) sind dir bestens bekannt und unterstützen dich schon mehrere Jahre bei deiner Arbeit.

Leistungen

Bei Expleo setzen wir auf Teamwork, Offenheit, Transparenz und Wertschätzung. Wir gehen unsere Aufgaben gemeinsam an
Bei uns erwartet dich ein internationales und multikulturelles Team
Bei uns sind alle gleich und wir tragen alle die gleiche Farbe: LILA!
Wir bieten dir Gleitzeit, ein ausführliches Onboarding, Home-Office-Möglichkeiten und unzählige Mitarbeiter-Benefits. Wir bieten einen Arbeitsplatz, der deine persönlichen Lebensumstände berücksichtigt und dich absichert
Man lernt nie aus: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns sehr am Herzen. Wir bieten interne Aus- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und unterstützen dich und deine perspektivischen Ziele
Wir haben Lust etwas zu bewegen, uns gegenseitig zu motivieren und freuen uns, wenn auch du deinen Teil zum großen Ganzen beitragen: Deine Erfahrung, deine Ideen und dein Engagement finden bei uns Gehör und werden honoriert
Unsere Kunden können sich nicht nur sehen lassen; sie gehören zu den Top-Playern ihrer Branchen, in den Bereichen Banken und Versicherungen, Automotive, Luftfahrt, Transport und viele mehr
Das soziale Miteinander ist uns wichtig. Wir setzen auf Teambuilding und Identifikation

Du willst mehr über uns wissen? Besuche einfach unseren Youtube-Kanal
und schau Dir unsere Videos an. Wir freuen uns über Deine Bewerbung und darauf, Dich persönlich kennenzulernen.

new_jobs.title: Fachkoordinator*in Microsoft Power Platform
new_jobs.description:
Willst Du gemeinsam mit uns das 36.000 Kilometer lange Berliner Stromnetz fit halten, ausbauen und modernisieren? Willst Du Dich mit voller Kraft für unsere 3,7 Millionen Kund*innen und für eine nachhaltige Stadtgesellschaft engagieren?

Dann unterstütze uns zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als

Fachkoordinator*in Microsoft Power Platform

im Bereichsmanagement der Abteilung Netzentwicklung in Berlin Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf.

Wir sind Stromnetz Berlin. Als Mitgestalter der Energiewende halten wir die Stadt am Laufen, geben ihr Energie und bringen sie zum Leuchten.

Mehr über uns erfährst Du hier: Über uns - Stromnetz Berlin

Die Arbeitsgruppe Digitalisierung & Datenmanagement im Fachgebiet Bereichsmanagement treibt die digitale Transformation des Bereiches Netzentwicklung voran. Sie entwickelt die Digitalisierungsstrategie weiter, schafft und nutzt moderne Datenstrukturen, digitalisiert fachliche Arbeitsabläufe und verantwortet das Management des bereichsspezifischen Applikationsportfolios inklusive Product-Lifecycle- und Release-Management. Darüber hinaus steuert die Arbeitsgruppe die zentrale Beschaffung, Einführung und Weiterentwicklung von IT-Lösungen innerhalb der Netzentwicklung.

Diese Aufgaben erwarten Dich:

Entwicklung, Betreuung und Optimierung von Business-Anwendungen und Automatisierungslösungen auf Basis der Microsoft Power Platform
Analyse fachlicher Anforderungen sowie Erarbeitung nachhaltiger digitaler Lösungen in Zusammenarbeit mit den Fachbereichen
Konzeption, Umsetzung und Weiterentwicklung von Power Apps, Power Automate Flows sowie den zugrunde liegenden Datenstrukturen
Integration von Fachanwendungen, Datenbanken und Microsoft-365-Lösungen über Schnittstellen, APIs und automatisierte Datenflüsse
Koordination von Anforderungen, Fehlerbehebungen und Weiterentwicklungen mit Fachbereichen, IT und externen Dienstleistern
Begleitung des gesamten Lebenszyklus von Lösungen – von der Konzeption über Tests und Releases bis hin zu Schulung, Dokumentation und Betrieb

Wir suchen jemanden mit:

erfolgreich abgeschlossenem Studium der Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwissenschaften oder einer vergleichbaren Qualifikation.
guten Kenntnissen der Microsoft Power Plattform, insbesondere Power Apps und Power Automate.
Programmierkenntnissen sowie Verständnis für Softwareentwicklung, Datenstrukturen und technischen Zusammenhängen.
analytischer und strukturierter Arbeitsweise sowie die Fähigkeit, fachliche Anforderungen in technische Lösungen zu überführen.
Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Fachbereichen und Stakeholdern sowie eine offene und lösungsorientierte Kommunikation.
Interesse an Digitalisierung, Prozessoptimierung und modernen Microsoft-Technologien.
Plus, aber kein Muss:
Kenntnisse in der Anbindung von Microsoft Project Server / Project Online sowie weiterer Fachanwendungen über Schnittstellen, APIs und Standardkonnektoren.
Erfahrung bei der Verarbeitung und Automatisierung von Projekt- und Portfoliodaten mit Power Apps, Power Automate und SQL.

Das spricht für Deine Karriere bei uns:

Work-Life-Balance: Wir unterstützen die Vereinbarkeit von Familie, Freizeit und Beruf z.B. durch flexible Arbeitszeiten bei einer 37h-Woche, diversen Arbeitszeitmodellen (z.B. Sabbatical, Gleitzeit, Teilzeit etc.), 30 Tagen Urlaub/Jahr, arbeitsfreien Tagen an Weihnachten und Silvester sowie einem Jahresarbeitszeitkonto.
Persönliche Weiterentwicklung: Wir fördern Deine persönliche Entwicklung (z.B. durch Entwicklungsgespräche) und unterstützen Dich durch individuelle Weiterbildungsmaßnahmen (z.B. Projektleitung) und bieten Dir ein umfangreiches Angebot zur Gesundheitsförderung.
Leistungen: Profitieren Sie von weiteren Leistungen wie einem Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket Job oder Firmenticket Berlin AB, Vergünstigtes Mittagessen in der Kantine, Jobrad-Leasing sowie kostenfreies Laden privater E-Autos an SNB-Standorten.
Arbeitsumfeld: Wir bieten ein Umfeld mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum zur Eigeninitiative und eigenverantwortlichem Handeln sowie eine offene Kommunikationskultur.
Toleranz und Akzeptanz: Mit viel Engagement sorgen wir für eine bunte, vielfältige Organisation mit Hilfe von Aktivitäten für Toleranz und Akzeptanz.
Finanzielle Sicherheit: Du erhältst eine attraktive tarifliche Einstiegsvergütung zwischen 62.000 - 75.000 € in einem krisensicheren Unternehmen. Durch abweichende persönliche Voraussetzungen kann eine Eingruppierung zu Beginn auch niedriger erfolgen. Profitiere von weiteren Leistungen wie einem Zuschuss zum Firmenticket AB, vergünstigtem Mittagessen sowie einem Jobrad-Leasing und einer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge.
Standort Berlin: Durch unsere Kooperation mit einem Berliner Wohnungsunternehmen unterstützen wir Dich beim schnellen Ankommen in Berlin, sofern Du für den Job nach Berlin ziehen müsstest.

So wird Stromnetz Berlin als Arbeitgeber (kununu.com) gesehen.

Bunt – spannend – vielfältig – Berlin.

Wir sind überzeugt von Vielfalt und Inklusion. Bewerbungen von Menschen jeglichen Alters, geschlechtlicher Identität, sexueller Orientierung sowie mit Migrationsgeschichte sind herzlich willkommen. Da wir uns Chancengleichheit und die berufliche Förderung von Frauen zum Ziel gesetzt haben, sind wir an Bewerbungen von Frauen besonders interessiert. Menschen mit Behinderung werden bei gleicher fachlicher Eignung besonders berücksichtigt. Das hört sich gut an? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung - gern unter Angabe deiner Kündigungsfrist sowie deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.

Bitte beachten: Wir nehmen aus Datenschutzgründen keine Bewerbungen per E-Mail entgegen!

Hast du Fragen? Wir helfen dir gerne:

Informationen zum Job: +49 30 295 30089

Informationen zum Bewerbungsprozess: Sarah Märtins,
E-Mail: sarah.maertins@stromnetz-berlin.de

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer - Tieto Caretech (m/f/d)
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

About us

Tieto Caretech is modernizing the Nordic health and social care sector with modular, open, and interoperable software. We develop and deliver high-quality software solutions and services that enable healthcare and welfare professionals to do their work even better and with higher efficiency - have more time to care.

We are a global team of professionals working on providing products and services to different sectors from healthcare to social care. We work closely with our Finnish customers to develop our own products and services. We want to provide solutions which enable healthcare and social care professionals to spend more valuable time with their patients and customers. With us you can build technology for the good of society and make your mark on the health and wellbeing of people in need.

About The Role

We are looking for a skilled Software Engineer to join a Patient Engagement development team. Our activities are directed at supporting the citizen-oriented parts of the healthcare system manufactured by Tieto and they include analysis, design, development, testing, maintenance, and release tasks. You will have opportunities to design and develop new features, maintain existing applications, and configure them in our SaaS environments. The work is going to be performed in a hybrid mode, giving the opportunity to work either from the office or from home, according to the agreed schedule.

Who we are looking for:

You live in (or at a commuting distance to) Szczecin, Warsaw or Wroclaw.
You have a good working proficiency in English, both spoken and written.
You have at least 3 years of experience of working professionally as a Software Engineer on commercial projects.
You have a full stack developer attitude with the primary focus on backend development
You have good practical knowledge of .Net framework, .Net 8+, and SQL, especially the Microsoft SQL flavor, including the Service broker functionality. You can use the Entity Framework in C# to access and use the databases.
You are a person with confidence to take responsibility and ownership.
You have the right personality and attitude to work together in a team, learn from your peers and pass on what you’ve learned to others.
You consider the testing as a natural component of the development flow, both in terms of creating unit/integration tests as well as executing the manual tests in the test environments.
You are familiar with web services (REST, SOAP) and know how to develop, deploy, and test them using IIS as a host

Nice to have skills:

You have experience in developing software for the SaaS environments.
You have basic experience with Angular, CSS, HTML, Javascript.
You are familiar with Git and Azure DevOps

We offer

We offer you an inspiring position with great opportunities for professional growth. With us you will have the opportunity to directly influence your career development. If you have good ideas, people will listen to you. What's more, we offer you a job that suits you. At Tieto, we promote a healthy work-life balance and a friendly, caring atmosphere. We believe that trust fosters freedom and creativity. Our culture is built on transparency and active sharing – a truly open environment.

In addition to this we offer you great benefits and opportunity to work with inspiring colleagues. With us you will be working with highly skilled professionals and experience being a part of the Tieto software development network.

Did we get you inspired?

We look forward to your application! Interviews will be held on a continuous basis, so we encourage you to apply today. If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact Tomasz Lisowski ( tomasz.lisowski@tieto.com)

What’s in it for you?

With us you will be part of the important and meaningful work of developing healthcare for all of us. You have an important mission to make a difference that really matters. In addition, as a company we offer you professional growth, open and friendly culture, and an outstanding work-life balance! We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working.

Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle. We want to encourage you to keep up that curiosity and deepen your knowledge on topics you’re interested in. For example, we host a ‘Keep Learning Week’ twice a year, a week where everyone at Tieto has the possibility to join different training courses in a truly global setting.

We perform background checks on all final candidates.

Tieto declines calls from recruitment companies.

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

Diversity, equity and inclusion | Sustainability | Tieto

Stay alert to recruitment scams:

Tieto only communicates via @tieto.com email addresses.
We never ask candidates to pay fees or share financial details during recruitment.
If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Tieto, don't respond — verify it via our official careers site.
For more information visit Important Advisory Regarding Recruitment Fraud | Tieto Blog

B2B: 18 500 - 23 400 PLN + VAT

Inwedo to software house z ponad 10-letnim doświadczeniem. Pomagamy firmom sprawnie realizować projekty od wstępnej weryfikacji pomysłów po pełne wdrożenie. Łączymy solidne fundamenty inżynierskie z praktycznym podejściem do AI i nowoczesnych technologii, aby tworzyć skalowalne i niezawodne systemy, gotowe sprostać przyszłym wyzwaniom.

Jakie będą Twoje zadania?

projektowanie i rozwój aplikacji backendowej w oparciu o C# i ASP .NET Core,

new_jobs.description:
About The Role

In this role, you will lead the design of a large-scale cloud transformation initiative. You will define the target Azure architecture for a security analytics and observability platform, ensuring feature parity with an existing AWS environment while enabling expansion into new regions. Working closely with client stakeholders, cloud vendors, and engineering teams, you will drive architecture decisions, migration strategy, security compliance, and delivery planning.

Responsibilities

Design and own the target Microsoft Azure architecture for a multi-region security analytics and observability platform, ensuring scalability, resilience, and operational excellence
Analyze the existing AWS environment and define mappings to Azure-native services, including Kubernetes, storage, networking, identity, and data platforms
Create the migration and re-platforming strategy, ensuring seamless feature, security, and compliance parity across cloud environments
Lead architecture workshops, design reviews, and technical discussions with client engineering teams, cloud providers, and senior stakeholders
Develop and present delivery scenarios, solution approaches, risks, dependencies, and Level of Effort (LOE) estimates to support project planning
Define and enforce security, governance, and compliance standards aligned with SOC 1, SOC 2, HIPAA, and enterprise security best practices
Establish cloud networking, identity, access management, secrets management, and operational standards for multi-region deployments
Mentor and guide senior and mid-level engineers, providing technical leadership throughout architecture design and implementation phases

Requirements

10+ years of experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale Microsoft Azure solutions, including AKS, containers, Azure networking, PrivateLink, management groups, subscriptions, and IAM
Strong knowledge of AWS architecture and services such as EKS, S3, DynamoDB, EFS, VPC networking, and IAM, with experience mapping workloads to Azure-native services
Experience designing multi-region cloud environments with data residency considerations and high availability requirements
Hands-on expertise with Splunk Cloud, Enterprise Security (ES), SOAR, or comparable SIEM and observability platforms
Strong understanding of security, governance, and compliance frameworks, including SOC 1, SOC 2, HIPAA, PKI, certificates, HashiCorp Vault, Okta, and Microsoft Entra ID
Experience with CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, cloud automation practices, and configuration management tools; Puppet is a plus
Proven ability to lead architecture engagements, facilitate design reviews, and define delivery plans and effort estimates
Strong stakeholder management, communication, and collaboration skills in multicultural and distributed environments
Fluent English, used to influence technical and business decision-makers at different organizational levels

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer | Range Operations
new_jobs.description:
Hej Software Engineer!

Do you want to furnish the future to make room for everyone?

With us, you can feel at home at work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to stand up for yourself and others, creating an environment where everyone feels welcome. We invite you to open new doors, embrace mistakes, and grow from them. As our Software Engineer, you’ll have many opportunities to try things you’ve never done before.

We are looking for a highly skilled Software Engineer to join our Digital Product Area: “Product Engineering”, a part of Digital Engineering at Inter IKEA, Range. The Product Engineering Area is dedicated to ensuring an attractive, consistent, and efficient way of working for product development and our suppliers. Our goal is to establish a strong foundation for IKEA's product information, enabling its seamless use across the entire value chain. We are growing our team in Malmö, Sweden, but you need to have great communication and collaboration skills to be able to integrate our offshore team.

Your new job

We’re looking for a software engineer who wants to solve complex, real-world problems to make life at home simpler. Join us on our journey as we level up our technology to enhance everyday experiences. Your primary focus will be on developing solutions for the handling of materials in our product designers' work, and you’ll report to a software engineering manager. The impact of your work will touch homes and hearts around the world. On a typical day, you will:
Build and evolve our material management solution, a core part of IKEA's digital landscape.
Develop web applications, APIs, and cloud services using Next.js, .NET, and Azure.
Contribute throughout the product lifecycle, from discovery and design to delivery and continuous improvement.
Be part of a team that values collaboration, continuous learning, and openness, while actively sharing knowledge and supporting others.
Bring curiosity and contribute ideas that improve both our products and ways of working.
Ensure high-quality software through code reviews, automated testing, and engineering best practices.

What we’d like you to bring to the table

This role as a Software Engineer requires you to:
Be highly skilled and experienced within React, NextJs and Typescript, a minimum of 3-5 years of work life experience
Be highly skilled and experienced within C# and .NET framework, a minimum of 3-5 years of work life experience
Have good knowledge of Azure.
Have good interpersonal skills: active listening, coaching and facilitation.
Be an excellent communicator by communicating in a clear, structured and honest way – both with inhouse and offshore team and colleagues
Have a deep understanding of IKEA's core values and cultural principles as well as a mindset and way of working that reflects this

It’s a plus if you also:
Worked with CI/CD, Terraform (IaC), Github Actions and cloud services
Have knowledge of database technologies like MongoDB, Postgres DB
Have experience with Jest/Playwright for Frontend testing
Are skilled in building dynamic and responsive user interfaces with React

Welcome to SSC Space (formerly Swedish Space Corporation). We work with space technology, launch services and systems used by customers around the world.

With space organizations, research institutes, institutional and commercial actors as customers, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications, spacecraft consulting services, rocket and balloon systems, and much more.

SSC Space also has one of the world’s largest global networks of ground stations for satellite communications. We own and operate the Esrange Space Center in Kiruna, northern Sweden, with the aim of launching satellites in the near future.

Do you want to work with software used in rocket and balloon operations? Are you comfortable with technical systems, troubleshooting and close cooperation with operations and IT?

We are looking for a Software Engineer for our Rockets and Balloons department at Esrange Space Center. The role is practical, technical and closely connected to our launch operations.

As Software Engineer, you will develop, maintain and improve software and operational systems used before, during and after rocket and balloon campaigns.

Requirements

We believe you have solid software development experience, work in a structured way and can cooperate with different technical functions.

Additional desired skills include Swedish language skills, experience with C, C++, .NET, C# or Rust, agile methods, test automation, project coordination, a university degree at bachelor level or higher, and leadership experience.

Fluency in English.
Software development and system administration skills.
Experience from Linux and Windows environments.
Deep experience in at least one programming language.
Ability to work in multidisciplinary technical environments.
Structured problem-solving skills and strong communication skills.

Responsibilities

In this role, you will work with software and systems that support safe and efficient rocket and balloon operations.

Design, develop, maintain and improve software systems used for launch operations, mission support and campaign execution.
Manage software configurations, releases, documentation and lifecycle activities.
Support troubleshooting, testing, verification and validation of operational software and related systems.
Participate in procurement, development and implementation projects involving software, automation and operational systems.
Ensure software solutions comply with applicable security, safety and quality requirements.
Collaborate closely with IT and other technical teams across SSC Space.

Benefits

We offer you

A unique opportunity to contribute to a wide range of projects and play an active role in both the Swedish and international space industry.
An excellent opportunity for personal and career development.
An exciting, international workplace characterized by an open atmosphere and proud employees all over the world.

In addition to vacation and traditional public holidays, we offer extra paid leave throughout the year, such as time off between Christmas and New Year, Ascension Day, amounting to 6-11 extra days depending on the calendar.

Health benefits such as voluntary health insurance and regular health checks for eligible employees.
Access to a benefit bike through a tax-efficient leasing program.
Support for employee-driven activities that promote connection, health, and culture across teams.

Under Test: SQL Server, PostgreSQL, NoSQL; Kafka / ActiveMQ; AI risk models & data feeds; React visualization UIs

Use AI tooling to accelerate test creation, coverage analysis and maintenance.

new_jobs.title: Software Architect (Backend-focused)
new_jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Software Architect
to lead the design and evolution of various backend systems for our clients' platforms. This is a client-facing technical leadership role where you will work across multiple projects and stakeholders, translating client requirements into technical solutions that hold up in production.

While the primary focus is backend architecture, the role also requires good working knowledge of cloud infrastructure and security, since backend design decisions now shape deployment and security choices too. Frontend is not part of the core responsibilities, but familiarity with how backend design decisions affect frontend integration is expected. Increasingly, client projects call for backend systems that incorporate AI/LLM-powered features (chat interfaces, retrieval-augmented generation, copilots, automation). You will be expected to architect these components with the same rigor as any other backend service, covering data pipelines, APIs, security, and scalability, rather than treating them as a separate discipline.

Responsibilities

Design and own end-to-end backend architecture (APIs, services, data models, and integration patterns) for client projects of varying scale and complexity
Define and evolve architectural patterns (microservices, modular monoliths, event-driven architecture, API-first design) appropriate to each client's context and constraints
Translate business and functional requirements from clients into technical designs, estimates, and delivery plans
Design cloud-native and containerized solutions (Kubernetes, Docker) across major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), including hybrid and multi-cloud scenarios where relevant
Build security into the architecture from day one: authentication/authorization (OAuth2/OIDC), secrets and identity management, data protection, and alignment with standards such as OWASP
Define and govern API contracts, integration standards, and data flow between services and external systems
Guide and mentor development teams on architectural decisions, design patterns, coding standards, and technical debt management
Assess feasibility and trade-offs of proposed solutions and explain them clearly to technical and business stakeholders
Participate in pre-sales and proposal activities: contribute architecture sections, technical estimates, and solution design for client-facing bids and technical audiences
Design and integrate AI/LLM-powered capabilities into backend systems - including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, vector search, prompt/response handling, and integration with LLM providers or self-hosted models
Define data architecture for AI use cases: ingestion, chunking, embedding, and retrieval pipelines, along with the data governance and access controls around them
Evaluate build-vs-buy and vendor decisions for AI tooling (LLM APIs, vector databases, orchestration frameworks) based on client requirements, cost, and data sensitivity
Apply security and compliance thinking specific to AI systems: data leakage risks, prompt injection, access control on retrieved content, and responsible handling of client data used in AI pipelines

Skills & Experience

Hands-on backend software development experience, with at least 2-3 years in an architect or technical lead capacity
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience)
Strong command of at least one major backend ecosystem (e.g., Java/Spring, .NET, or Python) and the ability to reason across others
Solid experience designing distributed systems, RESTful and/or event-driven APIs, and data models (relational and NoSQL)
Practical experience with cloud platforms (AWS and/or Azure) and cloud-native architecture (containers, orchestration)
Working knowledge of application and infrastructure security principles
Understanding of non-functional requirements: scalability, availability, performance, and resilience/failover design
Working understanding of LLM-based architectures: how RAG pipelines, embeddings, and vector search fit into a backend system, and how to integrate LLM APIs or self-hosted models into production services
Ability to assess, explain and draw existing systems and propose plans for incremental migration or rewriting
Strong communication and documentation skills (able to explain architectural decisions to both engineers and business/client stakeholders)
Comfortable working directly with clients: requirements gathering, technical workshops, and presenting solutions to steering committees or non-technical audiences
Willingness to travel to customer sites and events as required

Nice to Have

Exposure to frontend architecture (React, Angular, or similar) sufficient to guide full-stack integration decisions, even if not hands-on
Familiarity with security-specific tooling or practices: penetration testing basics, vulnerability scanning, or compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR-related technical controls)
Hands-on experience building or productionizing RAG systems, agentic workflows, or AI copilots
Familiarity with vector databases and embedding models
Understanding of LLM evaluation, guardrails, and cost/latency optimization for production AI features
Experience fine-tuning or self-hosting open-weight models for cost or data-sensitive client environments
Prior involvement in technical pre-sales, RFP responses, or solution architecture for client proposals
Experience mentoring or leading distributed/remote development teams
